items.summaryOriginal: My comment on EmbeddingGemma 2 — Hacker News. I really appreciate that EmbeddingGemma 2 is under the Apache 2.0 license. For embedding models in particular, I don't think it makes sense to use a closed, proprietary, hosted-only model. Most applications of embedding models involve calculating thousands or even millions of embedding vectors and storing them for later comparison. If your model is proprietary, the vendor is likely someday going to decide to stop offering that model. They'll have a better model to replace it, but you still need to pay to re-calculate those millions of stored existing vectors. (In April 2024 OpenAI offered to "cover the financial cost of users re-embedding content with these new models" - https://openai.com/index/gpt-4-api-general-availability/ - but I don't think that's something we can rely on from every provider.) Notably, I don't want to host the model myself . I'd much rather pay a provider for a hosted model while knowing that if they ever stop hosting it I can run the open weights version myself - or find another vendor who can do that for me. Tags: google , ai , generative-ai , embeddings , gemma

items.summaryEn: Simon Willison comments on EmbeddingGemma 2 on Hacker News, praising its Apache 2.0 license and explaining why embedding models should not be closed, proprietary, hosted-only services.
items.detailZh:
Simon Willison 在 Hacker News 上对 EmbeddingGemma 2 发表评论，核心观点是赞赏该模型采用 Apache 2.0 许可证。他认为，对于嵌入模型而言，使用闭源、专有、仅托管的形式并不合理。

他解释，大多数嵌入模型的应用场景涉及计算成千上万甚至数百万个嵌入向量，并将它们存储起来供后续比较。如果模型是专有的，供应商未来很可能决定停止提供该模型。他们会有更好的模型来替代，但用户仍需为重新计算那些已存储的百万级向量付费。

他提到，2024 年 4 月 OpenAI 曾提出“承担用户使用这些新模型重新嵌入内容的财务成本”，但他认为不能指望每个供应商都这样做。

Willison 强调，他并不想自己托管模型。他更愿意付费给供应商使用托管模型，同时知道如果供应商停止托管，他可以自行运行开放权重版本，或者找到其他能提供该服务的供应商。

items.summaryOriginal: Introducing Mistral Large 4: Le chonk Mistral are back in the game. Today they're releasing a preview of Mistral Large 4, a 1 trillion parameter, 49 billion active parameter model trained on their own cluster of 3,800 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPUs. The preview is available via their API. They promise to release the open weights model at the "end of this month". The model only supports two reasoning levels - "none" and "high" - via the Mistral API. Here are both pelicans - the "high" one looks better, though surprisingly it only used 2,717 output tokens compared to "none" which used 3,275: On Artificial Analysis it scores 38 , just behind DeepSeek 4.1 Flash, which is a 552B model. It's a huge improvement on last December's Mistral Large 3, which drew this terrible pelican and scored 9 on AA . It's certainly not a Fable-class model, but it's great to see Mistral put out a model that's back to being maybe about 6 months behind the frontier. Via Hacker News Tags: ai , generative-ai , llms , mistral , pelican-riding-a-bicycle , llm-release

items.summaryEn: Mistral releases a preview of Mistral Large 4, a 1 trillion parameter, 49 billion active parameter model trained on its own cluster of 3,800 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPUs, available via API, with open weights promised by the end of the month.
items.detailZh:
Mistral 发布了 Mistral Large 4 的预览版，代号“Le chonk”。该模型拥有 1 万亿参数，其中 490 亿为激活参数，在 Mistral 自有的 3800 块 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPU 集群上训练。预览版目前通过 Mistral API 提供，官方承诺将在“本月底”发布开放权重版本。

该模型仅支持两种推理级别：“none”和“high”，通过 Mistral API 调用。在推理级别对比中，“high”模式生成的鹈鹕骑自行车图像看起来更好，但输出 token 数为 2,717，反而低于“none”模式的 3,275。

在 Artificial Analysis 评测中，Mistral Large 4 得分为 38，略低于 DeepSeek 4.1 Flash（552B 模型）。相比去年 12 月的 Mistral Large 3（AA 得分 9，生成的鹈鹕图像质量很差），这是一次巨大提升。

总体而言，Mistral Large 4 并非 Fable 级别的前沿模型，但 Mistral 重新推出了一个大约落后前沿约 6 个月的模型，标志着其重返竞争。

items.summaryOriginal: Google released EmbeddingGemma 2, an open model with 740 million parameters that converts text, images, video, audio, and code into vectors. It runs on-device, needs only about 191 MB of RAM, and outperforms some competing models twice its size, according to Google. Paired with a small open model like Gemma 4, it can run offline RAG apps without sending data to external servers. The article Google claims EmbeddingGemma 2 outperforms rival embedding models twice its size appeared first on The Decoder .

items.summaryZh: Simon Willison 在 Hacker News 上评论 Mistral Large 4，并引用 wren6991 关于基准测试饱和的调侃，随后用多个模型生成同一 SVG 提示进行对比。
items.summaryEn: Simon Willison comments on Mistral Large 4 on Hacker News, quoting wren6991's joke about benchmark saturation, then compares several models on the same SVG prompt.
items.detailZh:
Simon Willison 在 Hacker News 上就 Mistral Large 4 发表评论。他引用了用户 wren6991 的一句话：基准测试已经饱和，前沿模型现在是用“穿着渔网袜、在火星上乱穿马路的犰狳”来测试的。

Willison 表示自己忍不住做了这个测试，于是用同一个提示词让多个模型生成 SVG：提示词是“Generate an SVG of an armadillo in fishnet tights jaywalking on Mars”。

他分别调用了 Claude Opus 5.5、GPT-6.1-Sol、Gemini 3.8 Flash 以及 mistral/mistral-large-4 四个模型，并提到各模型使用了默认推理水平。

他还附上了一个用于渲染 Markdown 中 SVG 的工具链接。整条内容属于个人评论和趣味对比，没有给出各模型输出的具体质量结论或评分。

items.titleOriginal: Microsoft publishes Nobel economist's bearish AI forecast of just 1.5% GDP growth over a decade
items.summaryOriginal: Microsoft published a bearish AI outlook from Nobel economist Daron Acemoglu. He predicts about 1.5 percent GDP growth over ten years and at most five percent of jobs replaced. Bigger models won't move the needle, he argues. What's missing are practical apps that change how work gets done. The article Microsoft publishes Nobel economist's bearish AI forecast of just 1.5% GDP growth over a decade appeared first on The Decoder .
items.author: Matthias Bastian

sources.name: The Decoder AI

items.importanceReasonZh: 该预测来自诺贝尔经济学奖得主，并由微软发布，对AI经济影响的主流乐观叙事构成重要反调，影响企业投资与政策讨论。
items.importanceReasonEn: The forecast comes from a Nobel economist and was published by Microsoft, offering a significant counterpoint to mainstream optimistic narratives about AI's economic impact, influencing corporate investment and policy debates.

items.summaryZh: 微软发布了诺贝尔经济学奖得主达龙·阿西莫格鲁对AI的悲观展望。他预测十年内GDP仅增长约1.5%，最多5%的工作岗位被取代。他认为更大的模型不会带来实质改变，真正缺失的是能改变工作方式的实用应用。
items.summaryEn: Microsoft published a bearish AI outlook from Nobel economist Daron Acemoglu. He predicts about 1.5 percent GDP growth over ten years and at most five percent of jobs replaced. Bigger models won't move the needle, he argues. What's missing are practical apps that change how work gets done.
items.detailZh:
微软发布了一份由诺贝尔经济学奖得主达龙·阿西莫格鲁撰写的悲观AI经济展望。阿西莫格鲁预测，未来十年AI对美国GDP的累计增长贡献仅为约1.5%，并且最多只有5%的工作岗位会被AI取代。

他进一步指出，仅仅扩大AI模型的规模并不会显著改变这一经济影响。他认为，当前缺失的关键要素是能够真正改变工作方式的实用应用程序。

该文章最初由The Decoder发布，随后被微软转载或发布。这一预测与许多科技公司高管和投资者对AI将带来巨大经济变革的乐观预期形成鲜明对比。

阿西莫格鲁的观点基于对技术扩散速度和经济吸收能力的分析，强调AI的经济效益需要配套的组织变革和实用工具才能实现。
keyPointsZh: 诺贝尔经济学奖得主达龙·阿西莫格鲁预测AI将在十年内推动GDP增长约1.5%。
他预计最多5%的工作岗位会被AI取代。
他认为更大的AI模型不会显著改变经济影响。
他指出缺失的是能改变工作方式的实用应用。
该预测由微软发布，与主流乐观预期形成对比。
items.impactZh: 这一预测挑战了AI将带来巨大经济变革的主流叙事，可能影响企业投资决策、政策制定以及对AI生产力的预期。
items.interpretationZh: 已报道的事实：阿西莫格鲁预测十年GDP增长约1.5%，最多5%岗位被取代，认为更大模型无济于事，缺失实用应用。合理推断：他的分析基于技术扩散缓慢和经济吸收能力有限，强调应用层创新而非模型规模。
items.limitationsZh: 该预测为经济学家观点，并非确定性结论；具体测算方法和假设未在摘要中详细说明；实际经济影响可能因技术突破、政策变化等因素而不同。
